message: You're so predictable, and I've seen this routine a thousand times. 'Coward' is a label for someone who can't listen to the other side. You're not trying to engage in a discussion, are you? You want to dictate what people can and can't say, what policies are acceptable and what aren't. You're a classic example of a thought police, policing what people are allowed to think. Newsflash: your condescending tone and jargon don't impress anyone. You're a joke, and you don't belong in this or any other serious discussion. Your presence here is a discredit to the conversation, and I'm starting to think it's time for you to get a participation trophy and go home.
